# Zyro Studios
> Affordable Freelance Web Developer & High-Performance Digital Products

Zyro Studios (founded by senior freelance full-stack developer Sinan) designs, develops, and deploys custom web applications, high-converting e-commerce stores, academic portals, and modern business websites at accessible, affordable freelance prices.

## Core Capabilities
- Custom Next.js 15 & React Web Applications
- E-Commerce Platforms (Stripe, inventory, fast cart checkout)
- Educational & Academic Portals (Previous Year Question repositories, student portals)
- High-Performance Landing Pages & Corporate Websites
- Full Stack Systems Engineering (PostgreSQL, Supabase, Node.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS)
- SEO Optimization & 100/100 Core Web Vitals Performance

## Pricing & Packages
- Budget Starter Website & Portfolio: Starting at $99 USD
- Custom Full-Stack Web Application: Starting at $299 USD
- E-Commerce Store: Starting at $349 USD
- Academic & Educational Platforms: Starting at $199 USD
